from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,date
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from decimal import Decimal,ROUND_HALF_UP
import json,hashlib,re
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
ROOT=Path.cwd()
R29="reports/research/510300_bank_industry_constraint_source_probe_v1"
R30="reports/research/510300_bank_current_vintage_ratio_cause_identity_v1"
R31="reports/research/510300_bank_release_vintage_and_nim_definition_probe_v1"
OUT=ROOT/R31
def readj(p):return json.loads((ROOT/p).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def save(name,obj):
 p=OUT/name
 assert not p.exists(),"已存在不覆盖："+str(p)
 p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
protocol=readj(R31+"/protocol.json")
for parent in protocol["parents"]:
 assert sha((ROOT/parent["path"]).read_bytes())==parent["sha256"],"冻结父证据改变"
ledger=readj(R31+"/request_ledger.json")
assert len(ledger)==2 and len({x["url"] for x in ledger})==2
assert all(x["status"]==200 and x["raw_saved"] and not x["retry"] for x in ledger)
for item in ledger:
 raw=(ROOT/item["raw_path"]).read_bytes()
 assert sha(raw)==item["sha256"] and len(raw)==item["bytes"]
assert sum(x["bytes"] for x in ledger)==1088434
cells=readj(R29+"/原表九个拟议字段单元格与格式.json")
points=[];clocks=[]
for quarter,body_path,end_day in [
 ("2025Q2",R31+"/官方正文_data_docId=1221429.json","2025-06-30"),
 ("2025Q3",R29+"/官方正文_data_docId=1233335.json","2025-09-30")]:
 d=readj(body_path)["data"]
 soup=BeautifulSoup(d["docClob"],"html.parser")
 compact=re.sub(r"\s+","",soup.get_text(" ",strip=True))
 npl=re.search(r"商业银行不良贷款率([0-9.]+)%",compact)
 cap=re.search(r"商业银行（不含外国银行分行）资本充足率3?为([0-9.]+)%",compact)
 assert npl and cap,(quarter,"正文数值定位失败")
 actual={"不良贷款率":npl.group(1),"资本充足率":cap.group(1)}
 expected={"2025Q2":{"不良贷款率":"1.49","资本充足率":"15.58"},"2025Q3":{"不良贷款率":"1.52","资本充足率":"15.36"}}[quarter]
 assert actual==expected
 clock={"quarter":quarter,"economic_period_end":end_day,
 "visible_publishDate":d["publishDate"],"docEditdate":d["docEditdate"],
 "current_retrieval_date":"2026-10-02","statistical_end_to_visible_release_calendar_days":(date.fromisoformat(d["publishDate"][:10])-date.fromisoformat(end_day)).days,
 "docId":d["docId"],"source_path":body_path,"source_sha256":sha((ROOT/body_path).read_bytes()),
 "source_url":"https://www.nfra.gov.cn/cn/static/data/DocInfo/SelectByDocId/data_docId="+str(d["docId"])+".json",
 "public_page":"https://www.nfra.gov.cn/cn/view/pages/ItemDetail.html?docId="+str(d["docId"])+"&itemId=915",
 "exact_first_public_time_authenticated":False,"historical_original_version_authenticated":False,
 "own_attachment_count":len(d.get("attachmentInfoVOList") or []),
 "body_contains_nim":("净息差" in compact),"annual_page_link_in_body":("1208453" in d["docClob"])}
 clocks.append(clock)
 for field,val in actual.items():
  cell=next(c for c in cells if c["quarter"]==quarter and c["field"]==field)
  raw=Decimal(str(cell["raw_cell_value"]))*Decimal("100")
  shown=raw.quantize(Decimal("0.01"),rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
  assert shown==Decimal(val)
  term="商业银行不良贷款率" if field=="不良贷款率" else "商业银行（不含外国银行分行）资本充足率"
  pos=compact.index(term)
  points.append({"quarter":quarter,"field":field,"dated_body_visible_value_percent":val,
   "body_visible_publishDate":d["publishDate"],"evidence_excerpt":compact[max(0,pos-25):pos+105],
   "current_annual_table_parent_publishDate":cell["visible_parent_publishDate"],
   "current_annual_table_excel_cell":cell["excel_cell"],"current_annual_table_raw_ratio":cell["raw_cell_value"],
   "current_annual_table_unrounded_percent":str(raw),"current_annual_table_display_percent":str(shown),
   "rounded_values_match":True,"comparison_support":"DATED_BODY_ROUNDED_POINT_VALUE_ONLY",
   "historical_first_vintage_high_precision_supported":False,"admitted_to_original_model":False})
pages=readj(R31+"/方法论文_全部逐页提取.json")
assert isinstance(pages,list) and len(pages)==24
texts=[p["text"] for p in pages]
assert all("净息差" not in t for t in texts)
assert "当季度利息收入" in texts[13] and "当季度利息支出" in texts[13]
assert "16" in texts[13] and "Wind" in texts[13]
method={"source_path":R31+"/人民银行工作论文_2016_4.pdf",
 "source_url":ledger[1]["url"],"sha256":ledger[1]["sha256"],
 "printed_title":"货币政策通过银行体系的传导","printed_paper_number":"中国人民银行工作论文2016年第4号",
 "printed_date":"2016-04-08","http_last_modified":ledger[1]["headers"]["Last-Modified"],
 "http_last_modified_is_original_publication_date":False,"pages":24,"definition_page":14,
 "visually_reviewed_pages":[13,14],"nim_literal_occurrences":0,
 "sample":"16家上市商业银行，2007Q1—2014Q3，Wind季度财务报表",
 "asset_rate_proxy":"当季度利息收入/生息资产，再年化；脚注实际以整体资产收益率近似平均贷款利率。",
 "liability_rate_proxy":"当季度利息支出/负债资产，再年化。",
 "capital_proxy":"股东权益/风险加权资产，并非E30行业监管资本净额字段。",
 "decision":"REJECT_AS_REGULATORY_INDUSTRY_NIM_PERIOD_DEFINITION",
 "reason":"这是上市银行报表利率代理，不是同一行业监管净息差定义。不能转移季度/年化口径、推断监管息差累计或单季，也不重开个股研究。"}
gate={"study_id":protocol["study_id"],"status":"NOT_ADMITTED_TO_ORIGINAL_DAILY_SCORE_TRAINING",
 "dated_rounded_body_point_values":4,"rounded_same_value_current_annual_table":4,
 "Q1_independent_release_body":"NOT_LOCATED_WITHIN_TWO_FROZEN_QUERIES",
 "Q1_not_located_does_not_mean_no_public_source_exists":True,
 "high_precision_own_quarter_original_attachment":"NOT_ESTABLISHED",
 "net_interest_margin_period":"NOT_ESTABLISHED","full_original_quarter_panel_support":"NOT_ESTABLISHED",
 "all_original_mature_member_support":"NOT_ESTABLISHED",
 "first_seen_receipt_or_first_publication_authentication":"NOT_ESTABLISHED",
 "nineteen_population_break_and_2024_capital_break":"E29_CONFIRMED_UNCHANGED",
 "dated_body_point_values_do_not_approve_full_31_quarter_panel":True,
 "current_annual_workbook_does_not_backfill_original_quarters":True,
 "Q2_qoq_difference_does_not_authenticate_Q1_original_release":True,
 "no_drop_missing_members":True,"no_missing_as_zero":True,"new_features":0,"new_fits":0,"new_full_accounts":0}
now=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
status="COMPLETED_BOUNDED_BANK_RELEASE_ROUNDED_VALUES_NIM_PERIOD_AND_FULL_VINTAGE_UNESTABLISHED"
classification="PROGRESS_E31_NEW_Q2_DATED_BODY_FOUR_ROUNDED_POINT_VALUES_AND_METHOD_MISMATCH_COMPLETED"
summary="E31取得2025Q2独立正文（2025-08-15 17:00:07，不良率1.49%、资本率15.58%），复用Q3正文（2025-11-14 17:25:47，1.52%/15.36%）；全部四点与当前2026年度表两位百分比显示一致，仅支持带日期公开点值，不认证原附件高精度。统计期末至正文日46/45自然日，不等于首次公开认证。16家上市银行方法论文不是行业监管净息差定义；息差期间/Q1独立正文/完整原季度版本及原成熟池支持仍未建立，来源门未过。2查询/2新直链/1088434字节，0新拟合/标签/账户/源码，夏普NOT_COMPUTED、完整目标未达。"
result={"study_id":protocol["study_id"],"experiment_id":"E31","status":status,
 "completed_at":now,"classification":classification,"summary":summary,
 "directory_queries_used":2,"new_unique_direct_source_urls":2,"new_raw_source_objects":2,"new_download_bytes":1088434,
 "quarter_release_bodies_considered":2,"new_quarter_release_bodies":1,
 "dated_rounded_body_point_values":points,"release_clocks":clocks,
 "definition_paper_decision":method["decision"],"source_gate":R31+"/source_gate.json",
 "facts_report":R31+"/原季度公开值与净息差定义_研究结论.md",
 "new_fits":0,"new_training_labels":0,"new_full_accounts":0,"source_code_edits":0,
 "net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED","goal_achieved":False,"current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET",
 "orders_authorized":False,"new_prospective_forecasts_enabled":False,"all_frozen_parents_unchanged":True,
 "previous_goal_turn_classification":protocol["previous_goal_turn_classification"],"consecutive_blocked_goal_turns":0,
 "stop_reason":"有限版本/定义问题已回答；剩余预算不是扩大搜集或默认反复重试的理由。缺口保持，不注册模型。"}
report=f"""# E31：原季度公开值与净息差定义

本轮得到四个带原发布日期的公开比率点值，未取得足够证据把行业银行约束加入原日频评分。状态为 {status}。净夏普未计算，完整目标未达。

| 统计季度 | 当前保存正文显示的发布日期（北京时间） | 不良贷款率 | 资本充足率 | 期末到正文日期 |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 2025Q2 | 2025-08-15 17:00:07 | 1.49% | 15.58% | 46自然日 |
| 2025Q3 | 2025-11-14 17:25:47 | 1.52% | 15.36% | 45自然日 |

Q2为本轮取得的独立官方发布正文，Q3复用E29原件。四个数值均与当前2026-02-12年度表按原格式显示到两位小数的值一致。这只支持当前保存、带原发布日期的公开点值；不能证明当前年度表的1.491%、15.578%等高精度值当时已公开，不能认证原附件首版、首次公开或首次收件。发布日期晚于统计季末，不把季末当可知日。资本统计不含外国银行分行；2019总体及2024资本制度断点继续适用。

Q2正文没有自己的原季度附件，而是连接E29已核过、目前含Q4的年度滚动表。不得将该表倒填到原季度。两次固定查询内未定位Q1独立正文，不代表全网不存在；Q2环比描述也不能替代Q1原发布版本。净息差没有出现在Q2/Q3发布正文中。

本轮保存并实读人民银行2016年第4号工作论文《货币政策通过银行体系的传导》24页，定义页13/14均渲染目视核对。它使用16家上市银行、2007Q1—2014Q3的Wind报表：当季度利息收入/生息资产及利息支出/负债资产再年化，作为贷款/负债利率代理。资本代理是股东权益/RWA。正文没有净息差定义，样本与分子均不等同行业监管指标。因此拒绝把论文口径转移成行业净息差累计/单季定义。服务器2025-07-08修改日不是论文的原发布日期。

来源门继续为NOT_ADMITTED_TO_ORIGINAL_DAILY_SCORE_TRAINING：净息差期间、原季度高精度首版、完整31季度与全部原成熟成员支持未建立。本轮接受有限点值与方法不同的事实，拒绝据此重训、删除缺失成员、补0、改统计期间或宣称发现510300盈利规律。E26固定外需失败、E27路径目标缺口、E28叶成员/模型更新解释均保留。

实际执行2次来源查询、2条新唯一官方直链、2份新原件1,088,434字节；已知失败URL未重试。PDF第一次使用未安装的fitz读取失败，改用本地已有pdfplumber与Poppler成功；原失败执行记录保留，没有安装包。新增拟合、股票收益标签、完整账户与源码修改均为0。不运行无关全仓测试。

直接证据为[四点全部比较](全部四个公开点值_与当前年度表显示比较.json)、[两季度时钟](两个季度正文时钟与年度表链接.json)、[方法口径裁决](方法论文口径裁决.json)、[原始请求账本](request_ledger.json)、[来源门](source_gate.json)、[固定协议](protocol.json)和[完整结果](result.json)。当前市场观点为NO_VIEW，仓位UNSET，不产生前瞻或交易指令。
"""
save("两个季度正文时钟与年度表链接.json",clocks)
save("全部四个公开点值_与当前年度表显示比较.json",points)
save("方法论文口径裁决.json",method)
save("source_gate.json",gate)
save("result.json",result)
assert not (OUT/"原季度公开值与净息差定义_研究结论.md").exists()
(OUT/"原季度公开值与净息差定义_研究结论.md").write_text(report,encoding="utf-8")
save("本轮目标接续归属.json",{"previous_goal_turn_steps":["E29","E30"],"current_goal_turn_steps":["E31"],
 "current_goal_turn_classification":classification,"consecutive_blocked_goal_turns":0,"goal_status":"active","goal_achieved":False})
save("必要核对.json",{"all_15_frozen_parents_unchanged":True,"both_raw_sources_size_hash_match":True,
 "all_4_dated_values_match_current_display_only":True,"Q2_Q3_clock_delays":[46,45],
 "all_24_pdf_pages_extracted":True,"PDF_pages_13_14_visually_reviewed":True,
 "NIM_definition_not_transferred":True,"budget_limits_pass":True,"known_failure_retries":0,
 "new_fits":0,"new_accounts":0,"source_code_edits":0,"goal_achieved":False})
print(json.dumps({"实验":"E31有限问题完成","公开点值":4,"净息差期间":"未知","完整原版本":"未建立","原训练准入":"拒绝","新拟合":0,"夏普":"未计算"},ensure_ascii=False))
